abs.description: Computes the absolute value of each element in a vector register.

acos.description: Computes the arc cosine of each floating-point element in radians.

acosh.description: Computes the inverse hyperbolic cosine of each floating-point element.

adds.description: Adds two integer vector registers element-wise with saturation to [MIN, MAX] on underflow/overflow.

andb.description: Computes the bitwise AND of two vector registers.

andb_k.description: Computes the bitwise AND of two mask registers.

andnb.description: Computes the bitwise AND-NOT of two vector registers (~a & b).

andnb_k.description: Computes the bitwise AND-NOT of two mask registers (~m0 & m1).

asin.description: Computes the arc sine of each floating-point element in radians.

asinh.description: Computes the inverse hyperbolic sine of each floating-point element.

atan.description: Computes the arc tangent of each floating-point element in radians.

atan2.description: Computes the four-quadrant arc tangent of y and x floating-point vector elements.

atanh.description: Computes the inverse hyperbolic tangent of each floating-point element.

blend.description: Selects elements between two vector registers based on a mask (r0 when m=0, r1 when m=1).

cast.description: In-register bitcast/reinterpretation of a vector register to another datatype of identical bitwidth with zero runtime instructions.

cast_k.description: In-register bitcast/reinterpretation of a mask register to another datatype of identical bitwidth with zero runtime instructions.

cmpeq.description: Compares two vector registers element-wise for equality (a == b).

cmpge.description: Compares two vector registers element-wise for greater-than-or-equal (a >= b).

cmpgt.description: Compares two vector registers element-wise for greater-than (a > b).

cmple.description: Compares two vector registers element-wise for less-than-or-equal (a <= b).

cmplt.description: Compares two vector registers element-wise for less-than (a < b).

cmpneq.description: Compares two vector registers element-wise for inequality (a != b).

cos.description: Computes the trigonometric cosine of each floating-point element in radians.

cosh.description: Computes the hyperbolic cosine of each floating-point element.

cvt.description: Converts elements of a vector register to another datatype with numerical casting.

div.description: Divides the first vector register by the second element-wise.

div2.description: Divides each element of a vector register by 2 (via arithmetic shift for integers or multiplication/division for floats).

div4.description: Divides each element of a vector register by 4 (via arithmetic shift for integers or multiplication/division for floats).

exp.description: Computes the base-e exponential of each floating-point element.

fmadd.description: Computes the fused multiply-add of three vector registers ((a * b) + c).

fmsub.description: Computes the fused multiply-subtract of three vector registers ((a * b) - c).

fnmadd.description: Computes the fused negative multiply-add of three vector registers (-(a * b) + c).

fnmsub.description: Computes the fused negative multiply-subtract of three vector registers (-(a * b) - c).

gather.description: Loads elements from non-contiguous memory locations into a vector register using an index vector.

get.description: Extracts a single scalar element at index idx from a vector register.

get_k.description: Extracts the boolean truthiness of a single mask element at index idx.

getfirst.description: Extracts the first scalar element (element 0) from a vector register with minimal latency.

hadd.description: Computes the horizontal addition (reduction sum) of all elements in a vector register.

hadds.description: Computes the horizontal addition with saturation of all elements in a vector register.

hmax.description: Computes the horizontal maximum (reduction maximum) of all elements in a vector register.

hmin.description: Computes the horizontal minimum (reduction minimum) of all elements in a vector register.

hmul.description: Computes the horizontal multiplication (reduction product) of all elements in a vector register.

load.description: Loads elements from an aligned memory address into a vector register.

loadu.description: Loads elements from an unaligned memory address into a vector register.

log.description: Computes the natural (base-e) logarithm of each floating-point element.

lshift.description: Shifts each vector element left by a given number of bits.

max.description: Selects the maximum value element-wise between two vector registers.

min.description: Selects the minimum value element-wise between two vector registers.

msb.description: Masks out all bits except the most significant bit (sign bit) for each vector element.

neg.description: Negates each element of a vector register.

notb.description: Computes the bitwise NOT (inversion) of a vector register.

notb_k.description: Computes the bitwise NOT (inversion) of a mask register.

orb.description: Computes the bitwise OR of two vector registers.

orb_k.description: Computes the bitwise OR of two mask registers.
orb_k.latex: m_{\text{res}, i} = m_{0, i} \mid m_{1, i}

pow.description: Computes the first vector register raised to the power of the second element-wise.

pow2.description: Computes 2 raised to the power of each vector element.

round.description: Rounds each floating-point element to the nearest integer.

rshift.description: Shifts each vector element right by a given number of bits.

rsqrt.description: Computes the reciprocal square root of each floating-point element (1 / sqrt(a)).

scatter.description: Stores vector elements into non-contiguous memory locations using an index vector.

set.description: Initializes a vector register from a scalar array.

set0.description: Initializes a vector register with all zeros.

set0_k.description: Clears all elements of a mask register (all inactive).

set1.description: Broadcasts a single scalar value to all elements of a vector register.

set1_k.description: Broadcasts boolean truthiness to all elements of a mask register.

set_k.description: Initializes a mask register from an array of int32_t evaluating boolean truthiness.

sin.description: Computes the trigonometric sine of each floating-point element in radians.

sinh.description: Computes the hyperbolic sine of each floating-point element.

sqrt.description: Computes the square root of each element in a vector register.

store.description: Stores vector elements into an aligned memory address.

storeu.description: Stores vector elements into an unaligned memory address.

sub.description: Subtracts the second vector register from the first element-wise.

subs.description: Subtracts two integer vector registers element-wise with saturation to [MIN, MAX] on underflow/overflow.

tan.description: Computes the trigonometric tangent of each floating-point element in radians.

tanh.description: Computes the hyperbolic tangent of each floating-point element.

testz.description: Tests if the bitwise AND of two mask registers is all zero (returns 1 if disjoint/all zero, 0 otherwise).

testz_2.description: Tests if every element in a mask register is zero (returns 1 if all inactive, 0 otherwise).

tomsk.description: Converts vector elements to boolean mask elements (active when non-zero).

toreg.description: Expands a mask register into an all-ones (~0) / all-zeros (0) vector register.

trunc.description: Truncates each floating-point element toward zero.

wcvt.description: Widening conversion: converts vector elements to a wider datatype.

xorb.description: Computes the bitwise XOR of two vector registers.

xorb_k.description: Computes the bitwise XOR of two mask registers.
xorb_k.latex: m_{\text{res}, i} = m_{0, i} \oplus m_{1, i}
